# porch_user (Data Source)

Looks up an installation user by primary email (exact, case-insensitive). Requires an installation token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porch_user" "ada" {
  email = "ada@smith.example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Primary email address.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `public_id` (String) Stable OIDC subject.
- `status` (String) `active` or `disabled`.
